business_problem: Cultural tourism stakeholders sought to renew and commercialize Xi'an's heritage while preserving it. Traditional crafts faced long production cycles and a shortage of successors, visitors needed more immersive and responsive experiences, and Grand Tang Mall required connectivity to support dense visitor traffic and live streaming.
solution_summary: SCG and Huawei introduced the BoGuan Large Model, a multimodal LLM for cultural tourism, backed by intelligent-computing infrastructure and a domain dataset exceeding 1.2 PB of images, video, audio, 3D models, and structured text. Huawei says the corpus enables historically accurate generation for digital preservation, but does not identify its ingestion pipeline, storage products, or model-serving stack. BoGuan is used for craft and heritage content, short-drama production, and visitor services: the AI travel companion in the GO-SHAANXI app generates or adjusts itineraries and attraction-performance recommendations, while the Zhiying Camera mini-program combines visitor photos with AI-generated historical scenes. At Grand Tang Mall, China Telecom Shaanxi and Huawei deployed 5G-A using 3CC to support high-concurrency access, live streaming, and uploads. The story names no APIs, app-to-model integration mechanism, data store, or network topology.

At Grand Tang Mall, 5G-A supported large crowds and live streaming; average dwell time on the streams nearly doubled and GMV rose by 62%.

evidence_quotes: The dataset exceeds 1.2 PB of data, incorporating 31 million images, 4.4 million minutes of video footage, 2.18 million minutes of audio recordings, 510 3D models, and 960 million pieces of structured text.
With this model, I can complete a dough sculpture that used to take two or three months in less than a week.
Visitors can interact directly with an AI travel companion via the GO-SHAANXI app to dynamically generate or adjust itineraries.
By March 2026, this feature had already served over 4 million users.
Sales of related digital collectibles and creative merchandise have already surpassed CNY 2 million (approx. USD 0.3 million).
The average transaction value (GMV) has surged by 62%.
